aboutMe.intro: Hello, welcome to my Portfolio! I'm a Front-end developer with experience in React, Nextjs, Bootstrap, Sass, Styled Components and more. I'm passionate about technology and innovation! I'm from São Paulo state and often participate in Digital Innovation One bootcamps, and I'm studying at:
aboutMe.schools: Rocketseat, Alura Oracle One, TreinaWeb, Coursera. I have experience in Nextjs and React front-end projects.
aboutMe.learning: and I'm constantly improving my skills in Next and React, and in Backend with Java and Spring Boot.
aboutMe.available: I'm available for projects, CLT, PJ and freelance work
aboutMe.contact: feel free to contact me via Whatsapp, I'll be happy to contribute with my work 🚀
